cands.name: Ben Braver
cands.bio: Former teacher at Title I schools and progressive Democratic activist; USF graduate (economics), former intern for Rep. Kathy Castor and Young Democrats of America state/local policy director. Lost the 2024 state Senate race to Danny Burgess by about 21 points.
cands.local_ties: Grew up in Hillsborough County and attended USF (his campaign site, as reported by Florida Politics).

record.text: No elected office. 2024 Democratic challenger to Sen. Danny Burgess (lost by about 21 points). Platform: full-day VPK, higher teacher pay, voucher accountability, Medicaid expansion, state nonprofit reinsurance fund, cap on corporate ownership of single-family homes, statewide ban on new data centers.

money_notes.text: Raised roughly $10,000 through Oct. 2, entirely from individuals, consistent with his pledge not to take corporate money; just over $4,000 on hand. His committee Friends of Ben Braver reported no activity through Oct. 9.

endorsements.text: Rep. Jamie Raskin (D-MD), Florida NOW PAC, Emgage Action.

cands.gaps: Photo not found. No newspaper endorsement found. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.

cands.name: Karen Gonzalez Pittman
cands.bio: Tampa native and former educator (testing and evaluation for Hillsborough and Pinellas schools); Vice President of Public Affairs for Vein911 Vein Treatment Centers and Health Performance Specialists. Republican, seeking a third term; Vice Chair of the House Health Care Budget Subcommittee.
cands.local_ties: Tampa native (Florida Politics). Note: the worklist home_county_code is BRO (Broward?); I did not verify her DOE filing address.

record.text: Sponsored biomarker-testing insurance coverage (2024) and mental health/substance abuse services (2025) bills that became law; a 2026 stormwater treatment bill became law via a Senate companion. Publicly criticized Hope Florida in 2025 and was rebuked by Gov. DeSantis.

money_notes.text: Through Oct. 2: about $184,000 raised, about $115,000 on hand, plus about $69,000 in-kind including $52,000 in research and polling from the Florida House Republican Campaign Committee. Her committee Friends of Karen Gonzalez Pittman raised about $588,000 since 2023 (donors include healthcare and pharmaceutical interests, business groups and utilities).

endorsements.text: Florida Chamber of Commerce, Associated Industries of Florida, Florida Realtors, Florida Education Association, Florida AFL-CIO.

cands.gaps: No 2026 Tampa Bay Times endorsement found. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
